question: Three identical bulbs are connected in parallel to a battery of 6 V. If the current in the circuit is 0.6 A, the power dissipated by the battery is:
solution:
The correct answer is **__3.6 W__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Parallel combination

 
 
• Three resistors connected in parallel to a battery of voltage V are depicted in the figure below.
 
• In this type of connection, the resistors are typically connected on parallel wires that originate from a common point.
 
• The voltage that flows through each resistor is the same in this instance. 
 
• The formula for **electric power** is given by,** P=IV**

 where V is the potential difference in the circuit and P is the power and I is the current of electricity.
 
• Power can also be written as **P= I²R** and** P=V²/R**​
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Calculation**

 
 
• Three identical bulbs are connected in parallel to a battery, **V=6 V.**

 Current in the circuit,** I= 0.6 A​**

 We know,** Power P=IV**

 P= 0.6 × 6

 **P= 3.6W**
